panes.add.button.description: Button (an empty project or pane), and an item of the session toolbar's + Add ▾ (a quick add with the default provider and settings): adds an agent to the project. Keep it short.

panes.add.caretLabel.description: Accessible name of the ▾ beside the Add Agent button: opens its menu.

panes.add.caretTip.defaultMessage: Configure Agent and Add…, or Add Agent from Template
panes.add.caretTip.description: Tooltip of the ▾ beside Add Agent: its two menu items (use their translations).

panes.add.caretTipNoTemplates.defaultMessage: Configure Agent and Add… (choose the provider, where it works and its settings)
panes.add.caretTipNoTemplates.description: Tooltip of the ▾ beside Add Agent where templates are not offered (the Assistant). "Configure Agent and Add…" is its menu item.

panes.add.configure.description: Menu item (+ Add ▾ in the session toolbar, and the Add Agent button's ▾): opens the Add Agent dialog (provider, where it works, settings).

panes.add.fromTemplate.description: Menu item (+ Add ▾ in the session toolbar, and the Add Agent button's ▾): adds one agent of a saved template.

panes.add.menu.description: The session toolbar's + Add ▾ button: adds agents (the dialog, a quick add, from a template) and saves or loads templates. Keep it short.

panes.add.menuTip.defaultMessage: Add an agent (Add Agent…: choose its provider, where it works and its settings), or save and load templates
panes.add.menuTip.description: Tooltip of the session toolbar's + Add ▾ button. "Add Agent…" is its first menu item: use its translation.

panes.add.quickDetail.description: The detail of + Add ▾'s Add Agent: it adds an agent at once, with the default provider and settings, working in the project folder. Keep it short.

panes.add.templates.description: Menu item (+ Add ▾): opens the templates menu (save this project's agents and layout as a template, or load one).

panes.add.tip.defaultMessage: Configure Agent and Add…: choose its provider, where it works and its settings
panes.add.tip.description: Tooltip of the Add Agent button (an empty project or pane). "Configure Agent and Add…" names the dialog it opens: use its translation.

panes.agent.merge.description: Button and menu item (a worktree agent's pane): opens the merge dialog for its branch.

panes.agent.settings.description: Menu item and button (an agent's pane): opens the agent's settings.

panes.agent.stop.description: Button and menu item (an agent's pane): stops the agent's session (the conversation is kept). Keep it short.

panes.body.empty.description: A pane with no agent in it (the layout has more panes than the page has agents).

panes.body.ended.description: The bar under an agent's ended session (several panes: short).

panes.body.endedLong.defaultMessage: The session has ended. Resume it, or start a new one.
panes.body.endedLong.description: The bar under an agent's ended session (one pane).

panes.body.notRunning.description: A pane of an agent that isn't running ({agent}: its name, in bold; keep the <b> tags around it).

panes.body.retrySetup.description: Button under a worktree agent's ended session: runs its setup command again, then starts it.

panes.body.setupFailed.description: The bar under a worktree agent's ended session: its worktree setup command didn't finish.

panes.body.setupFirst.description: A stopped worktree agent's pane: its worktree setup command runs before its next session.

panes.body.skipSetup.description: Button under a worktree agent's ended session: starts it without its setup command.

panes.body.worktree.defaultMessage: Works in its own worktree on {branch}.
panes.body.worktree.description: A stopped worktree agent's pane: its branch ({branch}, shown as code; keep the <code> tags around it).

panes.chip.notRunning.description: An agent's status in the summary chip's list of agents: its session isn't running.

panes.chip.removing.description: An agent's status in the summary chip's list while it is being removed.

panes.chip.tip.defaultMessage: The project's agents by state: choose one to go to it
panes.chip.tip.description: Tooltip of the session toolbar's summary chip ("1 waiting · 2 working"), which opens a list of the agents.

panes.compact.busy.defaultMessage: Available once the agent has finished.
panes.compact.busy.description: The detail of Compact… (disabled) in an agent's menu while the agent works.

panes.compact.empty.defaultMessage: Nothing to compact yet: the conversation has no messages.
panes.compact.empty.description: The detail of Compact… (disabled) in an agent's menu when the conversation has no messages.

panes.compact.running.description: The detail of Compact… in an agent's menu while the agent compacts its conversation.

panes.compact.suggested.defaultMessage: Recommended: the context is over your threshold.
panes.compact.suggested.description: The detail of Compact… in an agent's menu once the context passes the user's Suggest compacting above threshold.

panes.compact.waiting.defaultMessage: The agent is waiting for your answer. Compact after it has finished.
panes.compact.waiting.description: The detail of Compact… (disabled) in an agent's menu while the agent waits for the user.

panes.drop.move.description: Shown over an empty pane while an agent is dragged onto it: dropping moves it there.

panes.drop.swap.description: Shown over another agent's pane while an agent is dragged onto it: dropping swaps the two ({agent}: the other agent's name).

panes.failed.dismiss.description: Tooltip of the ✕ on the bar of an agent that failed to start.

panes.failed.retry.description: Button on the bar of an agent that failed to start: tries the launch again. Keep it short.

panes.failed.setup.description: Button on the bar of an agent that failed to start: opens Agent Setup (installing or signing in to its CLI).

panes.failed.title.description: In place of a pane's "Session ended" bar: the agent's CLI exited before its session started; the reason follows.

panes.footer.compactionHistory.description: The last line of the hover of a pane footer's context: clicking shows the session's compactions in the Overview.

panes.footer.compactions.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# compaction so far} other {# compactions so far}}{over, select, yes { — consider compacting} other {}}
panes.footer.compactions.description: A line of the hover of a pane footer's context: how many times the conversation was compacted, and (over the user's threshold) a suggestion to compact.

panes.footer.costClick.defaultMessage: Click to see this session's details in the Overview
panes.footer.costClick.description: The last line of the hover of a pane footer's cost: what clicking does (the project's Overview tab).

panes.footer.costEstimated.defaultMessage: API-equivalent cost of this session, estimated by Hive from its tokens
panes.footer.costEstimated.description: Hover of a pane footer's cost (≈): Hive estimated it from the session's tokens at API prices.

panes.footer.costReported.defaultMessage: API-equivalent cost of this session, as the provider reports it
panes.footer.costReported.description: Hover of a pane footer's cost: the provider reported it, at API prices.

panes.footer.ctx.description: A pane footer's context used, in tokens ("120K ctx"; – before it is read). ctx is short for context: keep it short.

panes.footer.handOverAdvice.defaultMessage: Hand it over to a new conversation: click for Hand Over to…, and choose the agent itself.
panes.footer.handOverAdvice.description: What to do about a long transcript, in its hover (pane footer). "Hand Over to…" is the agent menu's item: use its translation.

panes.footer.modelTip.defaultMessage: {chosenAs, select, none {} other {{model} · chosen as {chosenAs}. }}{provider} {effort, select, yes {model and effort} other {model}} {live, select, yes {of this session} other {for new sessions}}{reported, select, yes { (effort as the session reports it)} other {}}. Change them in {where}.
panes.footer.modelTip.description: Hover of the model in a pane's footer: the model shown and the name it was chosen by ({chosenAs}; none: leave that branch empty), the provider ("Claude Code"), whether effort is shown too, whether it is the running session's or new sessions', and where to change them ({where}: "Agent Settings or Project Settings").

panes.footer.reading.description: Hover of a pane footer's context before its numbers are read.

panes.footer.settingsName.description: Where an agent's model and effort are changed, ending the footer model's hover ("Change them in …"): the two dialogs' names.

panes.footer.stale.defaultMessage: Couldn’t read it again just now: this may be behind.
panes.footer.stale.description: A line of the hover of a pane footer's context: Hive couldn't read the usage again, so the numbers may be old.

panes.footer.transcriptTip.defaultMessage: Transcript: {size}{limit, select, none {} other { (flagged over {limit} MB: Settings → Sessions)}}. A long conversation slows down the CLI and Hive, and compacting doesn't shrink the file: it keeps the whole history.{advice, select, none {} other { {advice}}}
panes.footer.transcriptTip.description: Hover of a pane footer's transcript size ({size}: "12 MB"): the size it is flagged over ({limit} MB, set in Settings → Sessions; none: leave that branch empty), why a long one matters, and when it is long what to do ({advice}; none: leave it empty).

panes.header.asks.description: Tooltip of a pane's status: the agent's question to the user ({question}, the agent's own words).

panes.header.asksSomething.description: Tooltip of a pane's status: the agent has asked the user something.

panes.header.failed.description: A pane's status: the agent's last launch failed.

panes.header.failedTip.description: Tooltip of a pane's state mark (stalled): the agent's last launch failed ({why}: the error).

panes.header.markIdle.description: Button beside a pane's unknown state, and an item of its ⋯ menu: tells Hive the agent is idle (its terminal shows it at its prompt). Keep it short.

panes.header.markIdleFailed.defaultMessage: Could not mark the agent idle
panes.header.markIdleFailed.description: An error's title: Mark idle failed.

panes.header.more.description: Tooltip of the ⋯ button on a pane's header: the agent's menu.

panes.header.notRunning.description: A pane's status: the agent's session isn't running.

panes.header.stopTip.defaultMessage: Stop this agent (the conversation is kept; resume it any time)
panes.header.stopTip.description: Tooltip of a pane's Stop button.

panes.header.unknownTip.defaultMessage: Hive has heard nothing of this agent's turn for a while and sees no sign that it ended: no Stop from its CLI, nothing in its CLI's records, no idle prompt on its screen. Until it hears more, the agent counts as busy and nothing is typed into it. If its terminal shows it waiting at its prompt, mark it idle.
panes.header.unknownTip.description: Tooltip of a pane's status when the agent's state is unknown. Stop is the CLI's event: keep it. "mark it idle" refers to the Mark idle button beside it.

panes.header.untaken.defaultMessage: A line Hive typed wasn't taken
panes.header.untaken.description: A pane's status: a line Hive typed into the agent's CLI wasn't taken.

panes.header.untakenTip.defaultMessage: Hive typed this, but its CLI hasn't taken it (it wasn't reading its input): "{line}". Click its terminal and press Enter. Hive types nothing more into it until its CLI takes it.
panes.header.untakenTip.description: Tooltip of a pane's status when a line Hive typed into the agent's CLI wasn't taken ({line}: the line).

panes.header.watchTip.defaultMessage: {watch}: Hive types a line into it when {kind, select, agent {{n, plural, one {it finishes} other {one of them finishes}}, waits for you or stops} lane {a review fails, a card is blocked or stalled, or a lane is due to merge or ends} other {{n, plural, one {the card changes} other {one of them changes}}}}, or at {limit} if nothing does. Nothing runs meanwhile, and it takes no other work.
panes.header.watchTip.description: Tooltip of a watching agent's status: what it waits for ({watch}: "Waiting for #12 → Review"), what wakes it (an agent watch: the agents finishing; a lane watch: lane events; a card watch: its cards changing; {n} is how many agents or cards), and when it is woken anyway ({limit}: a time).

panes.layout.name.defaultMessage: {layout, select, single {One at a time} columns2 {Two columns} columns3 {Three columns} grid {Grid of four} other {Grid of six}}
panes.layout.name.description: A pane layout's name: its button's tooltip and accessible name in the session toolbar.

panes.layout.wide.defaultMessage: {layout} (works best on a wide window, or with the sidebar hidden: Ctrl+B)
panes.layout.wide.description: Tooltip of a layout button with three or more panes (the session toolbar): its name ({layout}) and a hint. Ctrl+B hides the sidebar.

panes.leftovers.count.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# left running} other {# left running}}
panes.leftovers.count.description: An item of a pane's ⋯ menu, and a line of its badge's hover: how many processes the agent left running ({n}). Keep it short.

panes.leftovers.end.description: Menu item on the processes an agent left running: ends it or all {n} of them.

panes.leftovers.endFailed.description: An error's title: ending the processes an agent left running failed.

panes.leftovers.keep.description: Menu item on the processes an agent left running: keeps them running and stops listing them.

panes.leftovers.keepFailed.description: An error's title: keeping the processes an agent left running (and no longer listing them) failed.

panes.leftovers.tip.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# process this agent started is still running after it stopped. It may hold the project's folder or ports:} other {# processes this agent started are still running after it stopped. They may hold the project's folder or ports:}}
panes.leftovers.tip.description: The heading of the menu of an agent's left-running processes, above the processes listed: how many ({n}) its stopped launches left running.

panes.list.more.description: The last line of a list in a hover cut short (files, processes): how many more ({n}).

panes.locks.item.description: An item of a pane's ⋯ menu: how many files ({n}) the agent is editing this turn; its menu lists them.

panes.locks.title.defaultMessage: Files it is editing this turn:
panes.locks.title.description: Above the files an agent is editing (a worktree agent), in its pane's ⋯ menu.

panes.locks.titleShared.defaultMessage: Files it is editing this turn. Other agents in this folder wait until it finishes with them:
panes.locks.titleShared.description: Above the files an agent is editing (an agent sharing the project's folder), in its pane's ⋯ menu.

panes.menu.archiveStartNew.description: Menu item (an agent's menu): archives the agent's conversation and starts a new one.

panes.menu.cancelWatch.description: Menu item (a watching agent's menu): ends its watch, so nothing wakes it.

panes.menu.compact.description: Menu item (an agent's menu): summarises its conversation to shrink its context (asks first).

panes.menu.discard.description: Menu item (a worktree agent's menu): removes the agent and deletes its worktree and branch (asks first).

panes.menu.handOver.description: Menu item (an agent's menu): hands its work over to another agent or a new conversation.

panes.menu.moveLeft.description: Menu item (an agent's menu): moves the agent one place left among the project's agents.

panes.menu.moveRight.description: Menu item (an agent's menu): moves the agent one place right among the project's agents.

panes.menu.remove.description: Menu item (an agent's menu): removes the agent from the project (asks first).

panes.menu.reviewChanges.description: Menu item (a worktree agent's menu): shows its changes in the Git tab.

panes.messages.cancel.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Cancel the Message} other {Cancel the # Messages}}
panes.messages.cancel.description: Menu item on an agent's unread messages: cancels the {n} still waiting to be delivered.

panes.messages.cancelFailed.description: An error's title: cancelling messages left for an agent failed.

panes.messages.line.defaultMessage: {id} from {from} ({state, select, queued {waiting} offered {typed, not fetched or acked yet} other {its offer not confirmed}}): {text}
panes.messages.line.description: A message left for an agent, in the menu of its unread messages: its id, who from ({from}), its state (waiting; typed into the agent but not fetched or acked; or offered but not confirmed), and the start of its text ({text}, the sender's own words).

panes.messages.overdue.description: An item of a pane's ⋯ menu, and a line of its badge's hover: how many deliveries the agent didn't ack in time. Keep it short.

panes.messages.overdueTip.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {One delivery was not acked in time: the agent hasn't said it acted on it.} other {# deliveries were not acked in time: the agent hasn't said it acted on them.}}
panes.messages.overdueTip.description: In the menu of an agent's unread messages: how many deliveries ({n}) it didn't ack in time.

panes.messages.tip.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {A message} other {# messages}} for {agent} that it hasn't fetched or acked yet: offered as its next line once it is idle, or read with hive_inbox.
panes.messages.tip.description: The heading of the menu of an agent's unread messages, above the list of them: how many ({n}) for the agent ({agent}: its name). hive_inbox is a tool's name: keep it.

panes.messages.unread.description: An item of a pane's ⋯ menu, and a line of its badge's hover: how many messages left for the agent it hasn't fetched or acked yet. Keep it short.

panes.pages.button.description: Accessible name of a numbered page button in the session toolbar.

panes.pages.item.description: An item of the session toolbar's page menu (many pages); its detail lists the page's agents.

panes.pages.menu.description: Accessible name of the session toolbar's page menu (many pages).

panes.pages.menuTip.defaultMessage: Page {page} of {pages}: choose a page{key, select, none {} other { ({key} for the next page)}}
panes.pages.menuTip.description: Tooltip of the session toolbar's page menu (many pages): the page shown of how many, and the shortcut for the next page ({key}; none: leave that branch empty).

panes.pages.next.description: The › button of the session toolbar's compact pager (many pages): shows the next page of agents.

panes.pages.previous.description: The ‹ button of the session toolbar's compact pager (many pages): shows the previous page of agents.

panes.pages.tip.defaultMessage: {button, select, none {Page {page}} other {{button} (page {page})}}: {count, plural, one {agent {first}} other {agents {first}–{last}}}{added, select, yes {, with an agent the Assistant added} other {}}{key, select, none {} other { ({key} for the next page)}}
panes.pages.tip.description: Tooltip of a page button in the session toolbar: which page ({page}), or the ‹ › button's name ({button}; none for a numbered button), the agents on it by position ({first}–{last}), whether the Assistant added one there, and the shortcut for the next page ({key}: "Ctrl+Alt+PageDown"; none: leave that branch empty).

panes.processes.count.description: How many processes an agent left running ("2 processes").

panes.resume.allSessions.description: Last item of the session picker when it lists only the newest: opens the Sessions tab with all {n}.

panes.resume.button.description: Button (an agent's pane, its menu): resumes the agent's last session. Keep it short.

panes.resume.choose.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the ▾ beside an agent's Resume button: opens the session picker.

panes.resume.header.description: Heading of the session picker (an agent's Resume ▾) in a project with one agent.

panes.resume.headerIn.description: Heading of the session picker (an agent's Resume ▾): the sessions listed resume in this agent ({agent}: its name).

panes.resume.lastRunBy.description: A session in the session picker that another agent ({agent}: its name) ran last. Lower case.

panes.resume.listFailed.description: An error's title: the session picker couldn't read the sessions.

panes.resume.none.defaultMessage: No sessions to resume here yet
panes.resume.none.description: The session picker when the agent has no session to resume.

panes.resume.noneOfAgent.defaultMessage: {agent} has no session of its own to resume. Choose one with ▾, or start a new one.
panes.resume.noneOfAgent.description: Tooltip of an agent's Resume button when the agent ({agent}: its name) has no session to resume. ▾ is the button beside it.

panes.resume.noneOwn.defaultMessage: There is no session of its own to resume. Choose one with ▾, or start a new one.
panes.resume.noneOwn.description: Tooltip of the Resume button when the project's agent has no session to resume. ▾ is the button beside it.

panes.resume.openIn.defaultMessage: open in {agent} — click to show it
panes.resume.openIn.description: A session in the session picker that another agent has open ({agent}: its name). Lower case: it follows how long ago it ran.

panes.resume.pick.description: Menu item (an agent's pane): opens the session picker to resume one of its sessions.

panes.resume.recache.description: A session in the session picker whose prompt cache has expired: resuming it re-reads about {tokens} tokens ("120K"). Lower case.

panes.resume.sessionsTab.description: Last item of the session picker: opens the project's Sessions tab.

panes.resume.tip.description: Tooltip of an agent's Resume button: the session it resumes ({session}: its name) and when it was last active ({when}: "5 min ago").

panes.runtime.needsInput.description: An agent's status: its CLI waits for the user's answer.

panes.runtime.signin.description: An agent's status: its CLI waits for the user to sign in.

panes.runtime.silent.defaultMessage: Silent {known, select, yes {{minutes, number}} other {?}} min · state unknown
panes.runtime.silent.description: An agent's status (its pane, the agents table): Hive has heard nothing of its turn for {minutes} minutes (? when it can't tell: known is no) and can't tell what it is doing. Keep it short.

panes.runtime.starting.description: An agent's status: its CLI is starting.

panes.runtime.stopped.description: An agent's status: its session isn't running.

panes.runtime.working.description: An agent's status: it is working on a turn.

panes.safeguard.asks.defaultMessage: Its CLI asks what to do about it.
panes.safeguard.asks.description: An agent's safeguard note: after the stop, its CLI asks the user what to do (switch model, carry on).

panes.safeguard.idle.defaultMessage: Idle after the stop: give it a nudge.
panes.safeguard.idle.description: An agent's safeguard note: after the stop the agent sits idle; the user can prompt it to carry on.

panes.safeguard.stopped.defaultMessage: A safety classifier stopped a response{model, select, none {} other { on {model}}} at {time}{stops, plural, =0 {} =1 {} other { (# this session)}}.
panes.safeguard.stopped.description: An agent's safeguard note (its pane, a hover): its CLI's safety classifier stopped a response, on a model ({model}: its name; none: leave that branch empty), at a time ({time}: "15:12", hours and minutes on a 24-hour clock; in a language whose word before a time agrees with the hour, put it in brackets instead: "(15:12)"), and how many times this session ({stops}; once: leave it empty).

panes.safeguard.switched.defaultMessage: It now runs on {to} instead of {from} (since {time}).
panes.safeguard.switched.description: An agent's safeguard note: after the stop it moved to another model ({to}, {from}: their names) at a time ({time}: "15:12", hours and minutes on a 24-hour clock; in a language whose word before a time agrees with the hour, leave the word out: "(15:12)").

panes.safeguard.tools.defaultMessage: Before it, its last tool calls: {tools}.
panes.safeguard.tools.description: An agent's safeguard note: the names of the agent's last tool calls before the stop ({tools}: "Bash, Edit"; tool names, keep them).

panes.session.name.description: Accessible name of the session icon in an agent's footer ({session}: the session's name).

panes.session.new.description: Button and menu item (an agent's pane): starts the agent in a new conversation. Keep it short.

panes.session.openInTab.description: Menu item on the session icon in an agent's footer: reads the session in the Sessions tab.

panes.session.rename.description: Menu item on the session icon in an agent's footer: renames the session.

panes.session.renameButton.description: Button of the dialog renaming a session.

panes.session.renameFailed.description: An error's title: renaming a session failed.

panes.session.renameTitle.description: Title of the dialog renaming an agent's session (from its footer).

panes.session.tip.description: Hover of the session icon in an agent's footer, four lines: the session's name, when it started ({since}: a date and time), its id, and what clicking does. Keep the line breaks.

panes.tab.failed.description: An agent's state after its name (its name's hover on its pane, the summary chip's list): its last launch failed ({why}: the error's first line). Lower case.

panes.tab.mcp.description: A line of an agent tab's hover: the MCP servers it has on ({servers}).

panes.tab.notRunning.description: An agent's state in its tab's hover, after its name: its session isn't running. Lower case.

panes.tab.removing.description: Tooltip of the spinner on an agent's pane header while it is being removed.

panes.tab.resumeOpens.description: A line of a stopped agent tab's hover: the session Resume opens ({session}: its name) and when it was last active ({when}: "5 min ago").

panes.tab.reviewing.description: A line of an agent tab's hover: a card it reviews (its number and title, the user's own words).

panes.tab.role.description: A line of an agent tab's hover: its role (the user's own words).

panes.tab.session.description: A line of an agent tab's hover: the session it runs ({session}: its name).

panes.tab.title.description: The first line of an agent tab's hover: its name, its provider ("Claude Code") and its state.

panes.tab.workingOn.description: A line of an agent tab's hover: a card it works on (its number and title, the user's own words).

panes.tab.worktree.description: A line of a worktree agent tab's hover: its folder, its branch and the branch it was made from.

panes.table.agent.description: An agents table's first column heading: the agent's name and status dot.

panes.table.background.defaultMessage: Waiting on {n, plural, one {# background task} other {# background tasks}}
panes.table.background.description: An agents table's State column: the agent's turn ended but tasks it started in the background still run.

panes.table.card.description: An agents table's column heading: the card the agent works on or reviews.

panes.table.cardPrefix.description: The agent's card in a line of text (screen readers, a dialog's copy): {value} is the card ("#12 Title", "reviewing #12 Title"). Lower case.

panes.table.happens.description: An agents table's column heading (Start New All, Remove All…): what the action does to each agent.

panes.table.notRunning.description: An agents table's State column: the agent's session isn't running.

panes.table.project.description: An agents table's column heading: the agent's project.

panes.table.projectPrefix.description: The agent's project in a line of text (screen readers, a dialog's copy): {value} is its name ("in hive"). Lower case.

panes.table.state.description: An agents table's column heading: what the agent is doing.

panes.table.waiting.description: An agents table's column heading: what a watching agent waits for (cards, agents, lanes).

panes.table.waitingFor.description: An agent in a line of text (a screen reader's description of a project's agents): what it waits for ({what}: "#12 → Review", "B6 to finish").

panes.table.waitingPrefix.description: What a watching agent waits for, in a line of text (screen readers, a dialog's copy): {value} is what ("#12 → Review", "B6 to finish"). Lower case.

panes.table.watching.description: An agents table's State column: the agent waits for cards or agents to change (a watch); the Waiting for column says what.

panes.table.worktree.description: An agents table's column heading (Start New All, Remove All…): the agent's worktree branch.

panes.table.worktreePrefix.description: The agent's worktree in a line of text (screen readers, a dialog's copy): {value} is its branch ("hive/b1"). Lower case.

panes.template.detail.description: A template's detail in Template ▾: how many agents it has and its layout ({layout}: "two columns").

panes.template.heading.description: A heading in Add Agent from Template: the template's name ({template}) and where it is kept (lower case).

panes.template.layout.defaultMessage: {layout, select, auto {automatic layout} single {one at a time} columns2 {two columns} columns3 {three columns} grid {grid of four} grid6 {grid of six} other {{layout}}}
panes.template.layout.description: A template's layout, after how many agents it has (Template ▾ menu): its pane layout, lower case.

panes.template.listFailed.description: An error's title: Hive couldn't read the templates (Template ▾, Add Agent from Template).

panes.template.noneYet.defaultMessage: No templates yet: Template ▾ → Save Template… first
panes.template.noneYet.description: Add Agent from Template with no template: how to save one first. "Template ▾" and "Save Template…" are the button and its menu item: use their translations.

panes.template.ownWorktree.description: A template agent's detail (Add Agent from Template): it works in its own worktree. Lower case.

panes.template.save.description: Menu item (Template ▾): saves this project's agents and layout as a template.
